resolution.note: Sandbox drops localhost; the App token helper is cache-only when KRN_SESSION_CLASS=lane; tests pin both.

title: Lane sandbox sessions cannot reach the local Bitwarden server
body:
Why: Qwen second audit .krn/runs/qwen-research-2/report.md N6, verified at 6d713ae: .claude/settings.sandbox.json allows network to localhost and all unix sockets, and bw serve listens on [::1]:8087 unauthenticated; scripts/github-app-token.ts reads the App private key from it. A lane session can read the whole vault; the comment in src/cli/lane-run.ts that only the App token reaches a lane is false.
Outcome: the sandbox no longer allows localhost (or allows only named ports that exclude 8087); inside a lane session the App token helper is cache-only and never calls bw serve; the lane-run comment is true.
Proof: a test pins the sandbox network allowlist without localhost/8087 and a test shows the helper fails closed on cache miss when marked as a lane session.
